Transport Modes

Camión Refrigerado

A truck equipped with refrigeration units to transport perishable goods under controlled temperature; referenced in CMR waybills, sanitary certificates, and carrier schedules for cold chain logistics.

Quick answer: A truck equipped with refrigeration units to transport perishable goods under controlled temperature; referenced in CMR waybills, sanitary certificates, and carrier schedules for cold chain logistics.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Camión Refrigerado?

In this glossary, Camión Refrigerado refers to: A truck equipped with refrigeration units to transport perishable goods under controlled temperature; referenced in CMR waybills, sanitary certificates, and carrier schedules for cold chain logistics.

How is Camión Refrigerado used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "El camión refrigerado entregó productos frescos bajo estricto control de temperatura, adjuntando los registros a la carta de porte CMR."

Why does Camión Refrigerado matter in logistics?

Camión Refrigerado matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Camión Refrigerado?

Camión Refrigerado is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Camión Refrigerado belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A truck equipped with refrigeration units to transport perishable goods under controlled temperature; referenced in CMR waybills, sanitary certificates, and carrier schedules for cold chain logistics.

Operational example

The refrigerated truck delivered fresh produce under strict temperature monitoring, with temperature logs attached to the CMR waybill.
